messages.subject: Internal Error number: 457
parts:
Hello List



Thank you in advance for any help you can give me.



I am working with passive acoustic detections of harbour porpoises during
line transect surveys. I have managed to get abundance and density
estimates which seem accurate easily using CDS analysis without any errors.
I am now trying to use the DSM analysis to plot density changes over the
area we surveyed. However I am having trouble with the MRDS engine. It
won't run either half normal or hazard rate analysis due to Internal Error
457:



Initialising

Making data files

Making Data Selection Queries

**Error: Unexpected error **

Error Source: DataFileMaker.MakeObsQuery

Internal Error number: 457.

Internal Error description: "This key is already associated with an element
of this collection".



I haven't been able to find any other issues with this error on the site. I
am using single observer data and have followed the dolphin sample project
closely in hopes to avoid errors. I have re-loaded my data and checked it
several times to make sure nothing is listed twice or shares the same Label.
If anyone has any guidance on this it would be much appreciated.



Many thanks



Anna



Anna Cucknell

MCR International
